Information Contained in this Form 6-K Report

 

Name Change and Continuation to the British Virgin Islands

 

As previously disclosed in the Company’s Report on Form 6-K filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on October 26, 2026, at the Extraordinary General Meeting of the Shareholders of Ohmyhome Limited (now known as Ohmyswift Limited, the “Company”) held on October 26, 2026, the Company’s shareholders approved (i) the change of the Company’s name from “Ohmyhome Limited” to “Ohmyswift Limited” and (ii) the transfer by way of continuation of the Company from the Cayman Islands to the British Virgin Islands.

 

On November 3, 2026, pursuant to such approvals, the Company completed its continuation from the Cayman Islands to the British Virgin Islands as a BVI business company under the BVI Business Companies Act, 2004, and changed its name from “Ohmyhome Limited” to “Ohmyswift Limited.” In connection with the continuation, the Company adopted a new memorandum and articles of association under the laws of the British Virgin Islands, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 3.1 to this Report on Form 6-K and is incorporated herein by reference.

 

The Company’s Class A ordinary shares continue to trade on The Nasdaq Stock Market under the symbol “OMH” and under the existing CUSIP number G6S38M131. The Company is applying for a new CUSIP number to reflect the name change, continuation and related corporate actions, and will announce the date on which the new CUSIP number and related changes will become effective for trading purposes once confirmed.
